title: astragalus onobrychis f. microphyllus
intro: Astragalus onobrychis f. microphyllus, commonly known as the dwarf milkvetch, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. The health benefits of Astragalus onobrychis f. microphyllus include its potential to improve immune function, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus onobrychis f. microphyllus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, among others, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
